description: The true path of the miniature: a will read as a paper of its own, its date and the christening it speaks of set against the parish register; with the testatrix dead before the christening and the housekeeper away and the loser by it, the nephew who held the keys.

moves.why: The will says it was made on the third of March.
And it speaks of holding Thomas at the font.

moves.see: only Mr. Pym could come at the Bible
moves.why: Since her death the keys were Mr. Pym's.

moves.see: never came back to the Bible
moves.why: Mrs. Grice was at Frome from the day after the funeral.

moves.see: this one takes it from her
moves.why: And the new will would rob her of the house.

moves.see: four months after the will's date
moves.why: Thomas was christened on the first of July.
A will of March cannot speak of a christening in July.
Not on the third of March.
The will speaks of the christening.
Miss Pym died on the second of May.

moves.see: she could not have written it

moves.why: Away, and the loser by it.
The one who had the keys, and gains everything.
